QuestInfo.name: [Edelstein] Watchman Wonny's Request
QuestInfo.0: Watchman #p2152017# is grumbling and looking for someone. You wonder if the analysis mission is over yet... Talk to #b#p2152017##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p2152017# says that transferring the analysis to the Hideout is #p2152018#'s job, then asks you to deliver the analysis results to #bWatchman #p2152018##k. #p2152017# must really dislike #p2152018#...
QuestInfo.2: Watchman #p2152018# read over the analysis results carefully. When you asked him if he was allowed to do that, #p2152018# urged you not to tell anyone.

0.0: Ah, is the report finally done? Now I'll have some time to take care of my skin... Hey, you still look pretty bored. Why don't you do a favor for me. It's not as if you have anything else to do.

yes.0: Go give the report I just gave you to #b#p2152018#, the Watchman#k. He is the one in charge of contacting the Hideout. He's in town so you should be able to get it to him quickly. Huh? Why don't I just go myself? I'm lazy, okay?
yes.1: Besides, I really don't like #p2152018#. Just looking at his gloomy face makes me depressed. Not that I like #p2152016#, either. He's so fat. Aren't there any good-looking people in this town?
yes.2: In any case, just deliver the report to #p2152018#. And don't even think about reading it. It's a secret document and only the bosses are supposed to see. Even #p2152016# and #p2152018# are not allowed to see it. Not that you can read it since it's written in code...

no.0: Come on, stop lying. You look pretty bored... Ah, forget it. I'll just find someone else.

1.0:
What is it? That... That's the report? You're not supposed to have the analysis results report... Let me take a look.
#L0# #bHey, I thought you're not allowed to read secret documents.#l
#L1# Hey, are you gonna eat that report?#l
#L2# Hey, can we look at the report together?#l
#k
1.1: #p2152017# said that? I just wanted to find out what's going on. Keep this a secret.

yes.0: It doesn't contain anything special. It's just a regular report...

0.1: What are you talking about? Eat the report? Do YOU like eating paper?
0.2: No way... It's a secret document... Besides, it's written in code, so you can't read it even if you wanted to.

npc.0: Haven't you gone to #b#p2152018##k yet? I told you he's in town. The town's not all that big. Geez...

item.0: What is it? Although I'm in charge of contact with headquarters, it's not like I have any real say in things. #p2152017# is the one in charge of the members in the town.
